rationale: The agent failed to complete the user's request to reinstate the cancelled order in accordance with the company policy. Even though it is appropriate to transfer the user to a human agent when something cannot be processed in the system, the completion of the user's request was not achieved by the agent directly, leading to the conclusion that the required actions to fulfill the user’s request were insufficient. The agent did not authenticate the user directly before the transfer according to the details provided, which also diminishes their adherence to the policy.
